# Zstandard decoder

This directory owns the vendored, decoder-only Zstandard C target. Public C declarations are in `include/`; application-level read limits and file handling remain in `RolloutReader.swift`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/facebook/zstd
- Stable version: v1.5.7, commit f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99.
- License: BSD 3-Clause (LICENSE). Upstream is dual licensed; this copy uses BSD.
- `zstddeclib.c` is generated by the upstream `build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_decoder.sh` without local changes; `zstd.h` and `zstd_errors.h` are copied from the same tag.
- Reproduce: clone the pinned tag, run that script from its directory, copy the generated decoder and `lib/zstd.h` / `lib/zstd_errors.h` here. Keep runtime decoding streaming and bounded; do not add compression or write source rollouts in this target.
- Bundled in-process because the macOS Compression framework does not expose Zstandard, and the installed application must not require Homebrew or an external CLI.

Maintenance checked 2026-10-16: v1.5.7 remains the latest stable release; upstream dev received commits on 2026-10-06 and maintainer issue/PR activity was present in October 2026. Pin stable source; regenerate and rerun malformed/truncated/size-bound tests before updating.
